title: Receding Hairline: Causes, Signs and What Helps (Men and Women)
seo_title: Receding Hairline: Causes, Signs & What Helps | FullyVital
seo_description: Mature or receding hairline? Causes in men and women, the Norwood scale, what the research says slows it, whether it can grow back, and when to see a doctor.
summary_html: How to tell a mature hairline from a receding one, the causes in men and women, what can slow it, and when to see a doctor.
notes: Republishes the removed /receding-hairlines URL (9,452 impressions before removal) as the hub for the hairline, crown and bald spots cluster. That cluster is FullyVital's strongest existing hair-loss traffic: about 194,000 impressions on baby hairs, widow's peak, receding on one side and crown balding.

FAQ built from Google's 'People also ask' for 'receding hairline': slowing it, finasteride and the hairline, home remedies for the front, frontal fibrosing alopecia, plus whether a receding hairline at 20 is normal.
3 studies: Norwood's 1975 classification, a 2024 American Family Physician review of hair loss, and the 2017 treatment meta-analysis.

After publishing, these removed pages redirect here: /female-receding-hairline (26,174 impressions, has backlinks), /types-of-hairlines (24,165), /normal-hairline, /uneven-hairline and /traction-alopecia (9,679).
